message.content: Based on the conversation, Aisling has not directly shared her feelings about the ending of Red Dead Redemption 2. However, it is mentioned that the ending of the game left Aisling feeling conflicted. While the sacrifice made by Arthur was powerful and moving, Aisling also felt a bittersweet emotion because of the downfall of the gang, which left her heartstrings tugged in various ways. This suggests that Aisling found the ending deeply affecting, especially due to the emotional weight placed on the characters and their arcs.
